text: Kentucky voting machines switch Trump votes to Harris
Paper ballots should replace voting machines
It was user error: the voter tapped a small checkbox instead of the name field
It was an isolated incident, and the voter's ballot was cast correctly
The video clearly shows the machine selecting Harris
Even after a user error, a machine should not select another candidate
The machine was deliberately programmed or calibrated to do this
Musk's X made it possible to expose this
